title: Jamaican Chicken Tikka Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired wrap filled with marinated chicken tikka, served in a warm naan bread bowl. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: For the marinade
ingredients.notes: Combine 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp black pepper.

ingredients.name: Cucumber raita
ingredients.notes: Mix 1 cup yogurt, 1/2 cup diced cucumber, 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro, and 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder.

instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine the marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 6-8 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Warm the naan bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
5. Spread a tablespoon of butter on each naan bread.
6. Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
7. Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of chicken onto each naan bread, followed by a dollop of cucumber raita and a sprinkle of cilantro.
